name: navigator-staged-flow-decision
body: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` states the canonical staged sequence and its strict adherence: `spec-writer` → `spec-review` → `plan-writer` (skeleton) → `plan-review` → `plan-writer` (phases/tasks) → `plan-review` → `plan-review` (holistic) → the owning `implementer`/`*-implementer` → `implementation-phase-reviewer`. Every stage runs in order with zero skip, and implementation begins once the spec and the plan are review-green. `requirements.requirement.navigator-staged-flow` drives `domain.entity.staged-delivery-process`, which is realised by `solution.component.navigator-staged-flow-prompt` (which `contains` under `solution.container.opencode-suite`) and implemented by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`. The law `requirements.constraint.navigator-staged-flow-stated` governs the ordered stages, their owning subagents, and the gated-implementation invariant. This change-set edits only `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.
